question: Select the INCORRECTLY spelt word.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 3)**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Dilligence"** is incorrectly spelt. The correct spelling is "Diligence". (मेहनत)

 
 
• **Example:** His **diligence** in his studies earned him top grades.
 
 
 
• **"Diligence"** means careful and persistent work or effort. (मेहनत)
 
 
• **Example:** She showed great **diligence** in completing the project on time.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Particularly** (विशेष रूप से): Used to single out an individual member of a specified group or class.

 
 
• **Example:** She is** *particularly*** good at mathematics.
 
 
 
• **Betrayal** (विश्वासघात): The act of betraying someone or something.
 
 
• **Example:** His*** betrayal*** of his closest friend was shocking.
 
 
 
• **Vacation** (अवकाश): A period of time when a person is away from work or school, often spent traveling for leisure.
 
 
• **Example:** We are planning a*** vacation ***to the mountains this summer.
